name: Izumi Shinobu
source:
A childhood friend of the main character. She is a cheerful and serious class president, and is well-liked by everyone. 

She hates crookedness and injustice, and sometimes goes off the rails because of her excessive (and inflexible) sense of justice.

She is quite reserved when it comes to love, and is often teased by others.
